categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Changes JSON-RPC implementation in src/rpc/blockchain.cpp and functional test in test/functional/rpc_scanblocks.py under RPC/REST/ZMQ label.
categories.rationale: Fixes a correctness bug in scanblocks that silently returned incomplete scan results with completed: true when block filters could not be read. As noted in the description, callers got 'a relevant_blocks list that looks fine but is missing any match in the unindexed range, with no way to distinguish "no matches" from "range was never scanned"', risking client applications permanently missing relevant blocks.
